headline: MIL @ MIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIL 4.54 at MIN 4.01, with a projected total of 8.55. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIN: MIL moved -0.68 runs while MIN moved +0.43, changing the projected margin by -1.11 runs. NRFI probability rose +6.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Bailey Ober has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Brice Turang, Byron Buxton, Austin Martin, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Royce Lewis, David Hamilton because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
